68 maps · D64UnseenEvil-v1.0.3.pk3 + doom2.wad + doom.wad

Every texture Unseen Evil puts on screen

Unseen Evil ships almost no maps. It is an overhaul of DOOM II and Ultimate DOOM, and its Terraformer retextures the IWAD's own levels at load time from resources/d64ue_textures.*. So the name in a map lump tells you nothing about what you see — a sidedef that says STARTAN2 is a Doom 64 wall on screen.

This page replays that. All 663 Terraformer rules are applied in the engine's own order, including the conditional fitWidth / hasSpecial / lessOrEqualHeight / isGame blocks, and only then is the wall counted. Pixels come from the pk3 — 191 plain art files and 212 composites rendered from their TEXTURES patch lists. The 15 marked stock DOOM are what the Terraformer misses: original id art still showing through, decoded from the IWAD.

here counts uses inside the map the filter is scoped to; game is the total across all 68. light is the sector light-level range every use was found at. Ordered rarest first.
